name: service-center
description: Service planning & scheduling for worship teams — web, mobile and API.

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @service-center/backend
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @service-center/frontend
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @service-center/mobile
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @service-center/backend" "npm run dev -w @service-center/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @service-center/backend && npm run build -w @service-center/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
